violations.text: Fudge bars, PB cups, cookie dough cups, and cookie dough cheesecake cups were observed from an unapproved source. All food items were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Establishment is to only purchase food from approved sources. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The presence of mice is not controlled as evidenced by an accumulation of droppings in the ice machine/chest freezer room. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to clean any and all droppings using appropriate means of sanitization and is to have a pest control report available for inspector at the time of next inspection. Per PIC, pest control will be called today. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The door to the outside, located in the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea at time of inspection. Procedures printed and provided to PIC. New Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) observed with blackish/red/pinkish residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2025

Observed ice buildup in chest freezer located next to ice machine. Also observed a little ice buildup in whipped cream freezer located in front area of establishment. Ice shall be broken down and removed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2025

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 100 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2024
